reads.AORT: mixed — real cash EBITDA growth and share-gain drivers against a fresh guidance cut, an On-X recall, above-peer leverage and an -82% EPS-estimate collapse.
reads.BRBR: strongly-bearish — absolute EBITDA down ~40% on structural promotional intensity and still-falling consensus, with margin recovery unproven and unquantified.
reads.CNXC: mixed — a still-growing, self-funding EBITDA base offset by 4.1x leverage and a still-falling forward earnings path.
reads.EPAM: mixed — a near-floor multiple and net-cash self-funding sit against a self-inflicted North American growth gap with no committed near-term backfill.
reads.FUBO: mixed — a genuine contractual EBITDA-inflection story set against heavy cash burn, sharp within-year estimate cuts, and unquantified runway.
reads.IT: mixed — an all-time-high absolute EBITDA and sticky retention at a 3rd-percentile multiple, set against genuine top-line stall and falling new business.
reads.MVST: strongly-bearish — a stated going-concern doubt with a near-term maturity wall while operating cash flow and volumes are reversing this year.
reads.NCNO: mixed — self-funding margin inflection and forward-multiple compression pull bullish, but ~10% growth lagging peers and unresolved trailing-multiple basis keep it two-sided.
reads.NFLX: mixed — a still-compounding, high-ROIC self-funding platform with a long stated runway, but decelerating volume, negative revision breadth and a fully-priced forward multiple.
reads.SMPL: strongly-bearish — unchanged QoQ takeaway decline against a +10% category, plus a $391.9M brand write-down, signals structural share loss over optics.
reads.UBER: mixed — a durable, self-funding EBITDA/ROIC inflection with a long runway sits against a genuine below-EBITDA earnings markdown and forward-basis opacity.
reads.V: mixed — a genuinely high-return, still-compounding network, but long-duration growth is already capitalised in the price and the GAAP revision tape is softening.
reads.VITL: mixed — near-unlevered balance sheet and clear price-gap-reversibility evidence sit against a ~97% forward-EBITDA collapse and ongoing cash burn.
reads.VRRM: mixed — a permanent >10%-revenue customer loss and stair-step guidance cuts offset a genuinely growing, recurring Government segment and preserved self-funding.
